basic_info.description: Welcome to 697 Rhode Island Street, a unique gem nestled in the heart of San Francisco's desirable Potrero Hill neighborhood. This home offers an exciting opportunity for savvy buyers with a vision for potential.     Enjoy breathtaking city vistas and stunning views of downtown San Francisco, Salesforce, Bay Bridge and East Bay views! The existing layout provides a fantastic opportunity to enhance the current footprint or build your dream custom home.    The property's prime location ensures easy access to CalTrain, BART, SFO, UCSF, and highways 101 and 280, making your commute seamless. Enjoy the vibrant and bustling lifestyle with nearby shops and restaurants on 18th Street.    Don't miss this unique chance to make 697 Rhode Island your own and experience the best of city living. Schedule a viewing today and envision your future in this exceptional location!
